services.name: Private Events
services.desc: This legendary venue has been the stage for some the biggest names in music such as The Grateful Dead, Jimi Hendrix and The Doors. This history helps create the perfect location to host your corporate event, private concert, wedding, reception or business meeting. With access to the world's greatest musical entertainment, full-service event production, state-of-the-art lighting, and sound, custom menus and mixology - this unique venue will exceed expectations.
